A rational Lyapunov identity and 73 exact weighted-path/renewal/decomposition checks corroborate finite identities without replacing infinite-horizon proof.

value.rationale: This provides a sharp and nonmonotone stability phase diagram for an asynchronous optimization idealization: at identical fifty-fifty fresh/stale marginal rates, both very strong alternation and strong persistence destabilize an overrelaxed update, while independent delays converge. The precise two-boundary result tests a meaningful gap between marginal and temporal delay information and is not asserted to imply unproved nonlinear or systems-level extensions.
